experiment_title: Arabic Character CNN Classifier (30 Complete Epochs)

overfitting_analysis.comment: Minimal gap between training and validation accuracy demonstrates excellent generalization with Dropout and BatchNorm regularizations.

relevance_to_krishilens.reason: Successfully trains a real deep learning CNN for 30 epochs on Arabic letter glyphs, but Arabic alphabet characters have no overlap with Indian pesticide packaging in English, Hindi, or Gujarati.
